pages.text: Growthcraft Apiary works best alongside vanilla bee keeping. Use vanilla bees, nests, and hives for bee production, or pair Growthcraft with the Productivity Bees mod for a deeper bee system.
Vanilla bee keeping starts with flowers and trees.
Place flowers within two blocks of an oak or birch sapling before it grows.$(br2)When the tree grows, it has a chance to generate with a bee nest.
Growthcraft honey combs can be pressed into honey or used in mead production. Vanilla honeycomb can also be used in Growthcraft mead recipes.
Growthcraft no longer maintains its own bee box workflow. Use vanilla bees, nests, and hives for active bee keeping; Growthcraft continues the process with honey, wax, and mead content.
